findings.claim: The opencode mapper rewrites any name containing an underscore into mcp__<server>__<tool>, with only one built-in excluded by name. Built-in OpenCode tools with underscores other than experimental_image_generate (e.g. a future todo_write, web_fetch style name) would be remapped to a fake MCP name such as mcp__todo__write. A policy keyed on mcp__ prefixes could then misfire on a built-in, or the gate could treat it as an unknown MCP server. Likewise a server whose name contains an underscore is split at the wrong place (memory_card_search becomes mcp__memory__card_search), so policies for that server silently never match, which is a fail-open for a deny gate. The behavior is documented but not enforced or diagnosed.

Tests do not cover a server name with an underscore or other underscore-containing built-ins, so the first-underscore split limitation and the single-exclusion list are untested and the misclassification risk in F1 is not pinned.
